pass1.scope: Admission certificate and mutation boundaries; original AP1/JF2 compatibility
findings_fixed: Generalized admission must retain exact source certificate equality, not only current archive validity.
Repository reference coverage must remain broad; live-tree metadata filtering is a separate scan.
Raw SHA must be recomputed at apply even when size and mtime match.
Unavailable or warning-bearing lsof must refuse.

pass2.scope: Live process visibility, ignored pointers, per-row revalidation and journaling
findings_fixed: Gitignored live pointer must be scanned as an explicit file.
Live-tree metadata must be scanned with --no-ignore.
Protect both bare and suffixed live arm names.
verified: Process ps must show init and self; pgrep errors, denied ps, malformed visibility and active owner all refuse.
All source/hash/memo/observation pins are revalidated before deletion.
PRE_DELETE fsync precedes unlink; parent fsync and DELETED journal precede atomic ledger checkpoint.
Two-drive free space is reported separately and summed; target remains full admitted logical bytes.

boundaries: Temporary fixture tests are implementation tests, not evidence of real reclaimed bytes.
MAIN receipt reports approximately 23:50Z, later than tool time during reading; retained as reported, never used to waive live apply gates.
An optional duplicate current-chain precheck was interrupted to avoid competing with MAIN hashing; final planner performs the required current-chain validation.
